fieldValues.policy_title: Domain: do we know where it belongs?
fieldValues.policy_explanation: How sure the programme is of the domain the item belongs to, and so of the group that holds it. Domain confidence does not select a care mode in this seed; it ranks strong items for pulling forward and tells routing how sure the placement is. A rule may name it, as domain>=<level>, once practice shows it should.
